<thought>Considering the fragments “CC(=O)C” (acetone) and “CC(=O)O” (acetic acid), a plausible combined structure that incorporates both fragments and fits the molecular formula C₈H₁₂O₂ is the molecule where a central carbon is attached to both a carbonyl and an acetate group, giving the SMILES “CC(=O)C(C(=O)O)C”. This SMILES is valid and matches the required composition.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)C(C(=O)O)C</final_answer>
